about.title: About the Community Atlas
about.lead: One map for the Bitcoin community: meetups, conferences, local communities, places that accept bitcoin, and Bitcoin-only companies. The data comes from open sources and is refreshed automatically.

sources.merchants: Places accepting bitcoin: BTC Map, from OpenStreetMap. Details are fetched live from BTC Map when you open a place.
sources.communities: Communities: the community directory of BTC Map, with their public channels only.
sources.meetup: Meetups: the public Meetup.com calendars of BTC Map communities. Placed at the community's city.
sources.planb: Conferences, meetups and workshops: the open event list of Plan ₿ Network.
sources.feeds: Community sites that publish their events in the Atlas format.
sources.ecosystem: Companies: a Bitcoin-only selection made by the editors of this edition.

contribute: A place is missing or wrong: edit it on BTC Map, the atlas follows.
Your community is missing: add it to BTC Map communities, with your Meetup or website link.
Your events are missing: publish them on Meetup, on Plan ₿ Network, or as a JSON feed on your own site, then ask to be added to the feeds of this edition.
A company should be added or removed: open an issue on GitHub with a source.
about.fork: The Community Atlas is free software (MIT). Fork it and change one profile file to publish an atlas for your city, country or region, with your own name, colours and events. You can also simply embed this one.
